 Twilight is being resurrected with an all-new animated reboot series in development at Netflix . With no connections to the previous movie series, the new show has found its new versions of Bella Swan and Edward Cullen.

 A new report on the series by Knight Edge Media has shed some light on Netflix's Twilight reboot. It reveals that the series has cast Sadie Stanley ( Karate Kid: Legends , Kim Possible ) as Bella Swan, who was played in live-action by Kristen Stewart. Julian Grey ( Fear the Walking Dead , The Matrix Resurrections ) has also been cast as the voice of Edward Cullen, replacing Robert Pattinson. No other cast members were revealed in the report.
 Sadie Stanley Is the Voice of Bella Swan
 SOMEWHERE IN QUEENS, Sadie Stanley, 2022 Image via © Roadside Attractions / Courtesy Everett Collection 
 Netflix sees great promise in the show. It was just revealed during Lionsgate's Q2 2027 earnings call on Nov. 5 that the streamer has ordered two seasons of the Twilight series . The company also noted that Lionsgate has "high expectations" for the series, expanding upon how the live-action films turned The Twilight Saga into a pop culture phenomenon. Whether the animated series reaches the same heights remains to be seen, but Netflix and Lionsgate are clearly optimistic.
 Original Twilight author Stephenie Meyer is serving as an executive producer on the project and has been hands-on with its development. Other EPs include Marty Bowen, Wyck Godfrey, Erik Feig, Meghan Hibbett, and Emily Wissink. Sinead Daly will serve as showrunner. 
 Midnight Sun Revisits the Story From a New Point of View
 Edward and Bella embrace on their honeymoon Image via Summit Entertainment 
 The animated series is an adaptation of Meyer's Midnight Sun . Published in 2020, the book retold the events of Twilight , but from Edward's point of view. Viewers will have more insight into Edward's internal struggles as a vampire and how it conflicts with his dangerous attraction to Bella. It's a story that adds a new perspective to Twilight while adding to the original story. Of course, Jacob Black will still have a presence to an extent as a romantic rival for Edward, but it's not yet known who will be voicing the role.
 Five Twilight feature films were released between 2008 and 2012. They were immensely successful, collectively grossing over $3.3 billion at the global box office. It ended on a high note, as 2012's The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn — Part 2 was the highest-grossing installment of the franchise, banking $830 million. With that kind of financial success for Twilight , it may have been a matter of time before the franchise was rebooted. If the animated show on Netflix performs well, there's also a good chance that more live-action movies are coming down the line.
 Netflix has not yet set a premiere date for the Twilight animated series.
